learnings: When an LLM API returns HTTP 400 errors for specific files, the audit tool should retry with a fallback model or queue those files for re-audit rather than propagating the failure to the final verdict as 'inconclusive'

The audit tool should distinguish between 'file reviewed and found safe' vs 'file could not be reviewed due to tool error' in the final verdict calculation—tool errors should trigger automatic re-audit of only the failed files rather than failing the entire package audit
Models should be prompted to explicitly flag when they cannot complete analysis of assigned files, so the orchestrator can route those files to alternative models without waiting for a full re-run
